components.css: .ds-install { display: grid; gap: 10px; max-width: 620px; padding: 16px; background: #0B0C12; } .ds-install-tabs { display: flex; gap: 20px; } .ds-install-tabs button { padding: 0 0 4px; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; background: none; color: #A3A6AD; font-family: var(--font-geist), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1.4; cursor: pointer; transition: color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-install-tabs button:hover { color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-install-tabs button[aria-selected="true"] { color: #FFFFFF; border-bottom-color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-install-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-install-cmd { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 6px 0 16px; border: 1px solid #2C2E34; border-radius: 8px; background: #151821; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: var(--font-geist-mono), ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.9375rem; } .ds-install-cmd code { flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; line-height: 1.6; font-family: var(--font-geist-mono), ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-install-cmd code::before { content: "$ "; color: #A3A6AD; } .ds-install-copy { flex: none; min-height: 32px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #0B0C12; font-family: var(--font-geist), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-install-copy:hover { background: #A3A6AD; } .ds-install-copy:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
AtlasScope is the brand. Agent Kit is its first product, and atlasscope.dev is the Agent Kit site. The system is the AtlasScope identity applied to a working tool: a near-black ink ground, white type, one raised slate tone, one muted grey, and nothing else. The name "Monolithic Minimal" is the owner's own reference board (black and white, a lit planet horizon, white pill buttons); it is used here as the working name for the system.

The homepage carries the one image the system allows, a photograph of a planet horizon, sitting under a solid ink header and above a solid ink strip that holds the install command. Everything a visitor acts on (the command, the Copy button, the counts) sits on a solid ground, never on the photograph. The rest of the site is a library of prompts and skills laid out as slate panels on ink.

The system has no accent hue. Emphasis comes from white against ink, from weight, and from the typeface: anything a visitor can type or paste is set in Geist Mono, and that is what marks it as a command.
keyCharacteristics: Four colours on dark surfaces: ink, white, slate, muted. Rules are muted mixed over ink.
The header and the homepage are ink in both the light and the dark setting.
Montserrat 600 for display, Geist for text, Geist Mono for commands and counts.
One white pill per view for the primary action; the second action is an outlined pill.
One photograph, used only as the homepage hero backdrop under a solid header.
The AtlasScope logo is ink or white only, sits on a solid field, and is never scaled.

rules.name: The Four Colours Rule
rules.body: Dark surfaces use ink, white, slate and muted, and nothing else. The two rule colours are muted mixed over ink, not new colours.

rules.name: The No Accent Rule
rules.body: There is no accent hue. A command is marked by Geist Mono, a primary action by a white pill, a selection by white text and a white underline.

rules.name: The Ink Everywhere Rule
rules.body: The header and the homepage are ink in both the light and the dark setting. They do not follow the visitor's light preference.

rules.name: The Dots Only Rule
rules.body: The six section hues appear only as small dots on library pages. They are not fills, borders, text colours or button tints.

rules.name: The White Ring Rule
rules.body: Keyboard focus on a dark surface is a 2px white outline, 2px off the element.

rules.name: The Three Faces Rule
rules.body: Montserrat 600 for display, Geist for text, Geist Mono for commands and counts. The wordmark is drawn as outlines; never retype it in live Montserrat.

rules.name: The No Label Above Rule
rules.body: No small label sits above a heading. A headline is the first thing in its block.

rules.name: The Read Before Paste Rule
rules.body: A command is never cut off on a phone. Below 720px it wraps and shows in full, so it can be read before it is pasted.

rules.name: The Solid Ground Rule
rules.body: Anything a visitor operates or needs to read exactly (the header, the logo, the install command, the counts) sits on solid ink or slate, never on the photograph.

rules.name: The One Movement Rule
rules.body: The only animation on the homepage is the photograph settling into place on load (1400ms, from 55% opacity and 3.5% oversize). Text is in place from the first frame. With reduced motion set, nothing moves.

rules.name: The One White Pill Rule
rules.body: One white primary pill per view. A second action beside it is an outlined pill. Two white pills never sit side by side.

rules.name: The Untouched Logo Rule
rules.body: The header logo is pixel-fitted. Never scale it, transform it, or set its size from CSS. The logo is ink or white only: no gradient, glow, outline or tint.

rules.name: The One Photograph Rule
rules.body: The orbit photograph is the only image in the system. It is used as supplied, only as the homepage hero backdrop, and only under a solid header.

dos: Do build dark surfaces from ink (#0B0C12), white, slate (#151821) and muted (#A3A6AD) only, with hairlines at #2C2E34 and control borders at #66686F.
Do keep the header and the homepage ink in both the light and the dark setting.
Do set the header as the AtlasScope lockup, a 1px divider, then "Agent Kit", in that order.
Do set every command, id and count in Geist Mono; that is what marks it.
Do use one white pill for the primary action in a view and an outlined pill for the second.
Do put the install command, the counts and the logo on solid ink or slate.
Do use a 2px white focus ring on dark surfaces.
Do show a full command on phones, wrapped, so it can be read before it is pasted.
Do read counts from generated content.
donts: Don't add an accent hue, or use amber, on any dark surface.
Don't use a section hue as a fill, border, text colour or button tint; the six hues are small dots on library pages.
Don't place the AtlasScope logo on the photograph or on any image.
Don't scale, transform, recolour, outline or shade the header logo, and don't retype the wordmark in live text.
Don't put a small label above a heading.
Don't add a second image, crop or regrade the orbit photograph for effect, or use it anywhere but the homepage hero.
Don't put two white pills in one view.
Don't treat the warm paper colours on light-mode library pages as the system; they are the earlier look and have not been migrated.
Don't animate text into place; only the photograph moves, once, on load.
